# Exact versions from the environment that produced the published files.
# Read from the `pip list` output stored in Loop0/000a_fcs_concat_exp_labelling.ipynb.
#
# UMAP and Leiden are only reproducible for a fixed random seed together with
# fixed versions of umap-learn, pynndescent, numba and leidenalg.  Loosening any
# of those four moves the embedding and renumbers the clusters.

# flow cytometry
pytometry==0.1.6
readfcs==2.1.0
FlowIO==1.4.0
FlowUtils==1.2.2

# single-cell data structures and analysis
anndata==0.12.10
scanpy==1.12
h5py==3.15.1

# numerical stack
numpy==2.3.5
pandas==2.3.3
scipy==1.17.1
scikit-learn==1.8.0
numba==0.63.1
llvmlite==0.46.0

# embedding and clustering
umap-learn==0.5.11
pynndescent==0.5.13
leidenalg==0.11.0
igraph==1.0.0

# plotting
matplotlib==3.10.8
seaborn==0.13.2
datashader==0.18.2

# notebooks, including the interactive backend that the gating notebook needs
jupyterlab==4.5.5
ipywidgets==8.1.8
ipympl==0.10.0
